title: Portals No Pigmen
description: Disables Piglins spawning from Nether Portals in the overworld
body:
# Portals No Pigmen

Stops Zombified Piglins spawning from Nether Portals.

This makes it less annoying buiding a portal in a chunk loaded area or piglins filling the mob cap in farms.

Inspired by [Piglin-Free Portals (not affiliated)](https://modrinth.com/mod/piglin-free-portals) Look at that project for a Fabric version.
